name: pterm-composable-nested-renderers
instr:
PTerm cannot embed literal text or an existing RenderPrinter in tables, trees, bullet lists, panels, bars, or heatmaps without pre-rendering strings. Expose RenderContent through TextContent and PrinterContent, and have ResolveRenderContent produce a measurable multiline RenderFrame. BigTextPrinter remains an embeddable leaf, not a content-bearing builder.

Every built-in renderer implements ComposableRenderPrinter.RenderFrame. Composed frames must participate in native hierarchy, padding, balancing, scaling, axes, grids, legends, and styling. Measure multiline content in terminal cells across Unicode, ANSI-styled, raw-output, and color-disabled rendering, preserving escape sequences and explicit line boundaries. Recursive composition fails atomically with ErrRenderCompositionCycle and a deterministic complete path in RenderCompositionError. Error and Unwrap preserve nested failure identity through errors.Is. No containing Render writes before every descendant resolves successfully.

Composition and WithContentData or WithContentAxis builders preserve value-copy semantics without mutating collections, printer configuration, or writer selection. Existing text and optional Content fields use one consistent precedence rule. Unchanged builders retain established Render and Srender output, suppression, and writer behavior.
